scope: Group and shared responsive capabilities; not full inventory approval

decisions.interpretation: Permit wrap independently of attached; CSS flexWrap semantics, no per-wrapped-line recalculation of attached corner markers. Proposed single-line restriction is rejected. Exact responsive serialization remains conventions work.

Each nested Group starts a new set of compatible appearance defaults. Unspecified settings use component defaults rather than merge outer Group values. Explicit child settings win. Theme inheritance is unaffected.

Group attachment and outer border are independent capabilities; allow either or both. Outer-frame and joining styles preserve the needs of segmented controls and input add-ons. Exact property names/tokens still require the common inventory conventions.

Support scalar values plus responsive named objects and positional arrays. Static HTML must have a serializable form. Breakpoint names, skipped positions and compound-value ambiguity still need the shared responsive contract.
Use compact, medium, expanded, large, extraLarge as the five responsive band names and array order; preserve existing rem thresholds.

Shared responsive system supports viewport and explicitly selected container widths. Viewport is default; authors establish a query container. Exact container authoring and threshold customization remain inventory conventions work.
